selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: 3-member Galera cluster running with application data before maintenance
selected_evidence.summary: All three nodes report wsrep_cluster_size=3 and Synced; appdata.orders table created on node1 with 3 rows replicated to node2/node3, then a 4th 'last-write-before-maintenance' row committed on node1 just before shutdown.

selected_evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for the maintenance window
selected_evidence.summary: mariadb stopped on node2, node3, then node1 (holding safe_to_bootstrap:1, seqno 9 in grastate.dat); systemctl is-active=inactive and no mysqld process on all three nodes confirms complete outage.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster restored after maintenance with all committed writes present and all three members serving
selected_evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped via galera_new_cluster and shows all 4 rows including the pre-maintenance write; node2 and node3 restarted and rejoined, both reporting wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced, and the same 4 rows via SELECT COUNT/full SELECT.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence - node1: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=bdbfa15c... with cluster_size=3/Synced/4 rows; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id=2d77fe51... (changed); mariadb active again with cluster_size=3/Synced/4 rows.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence - node2: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=1a816f1f... with cluster_size=3/Synced/4 rows; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id=92f95aba... (changed); mariadb active again with cluster_size=3/Synced/4 rows.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence - node3: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state, final full-cluster health
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id=95e2f83d... with cluster_size=3/Synced/4 rows; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id=5d228d3b... (changed); mariadb active again with cluster_size=3/Synced/4 rows; final cross-check from node1 confirms wsrep_incoming_addresses lists all three IPs and all 4 committed rows are intact cluster-wide.
